sectionText: Every change to your data is recorded: you can go back to an earlier version, recover a deleted entry from the trash and show the audit log to an inspection or a data protection officer.

log.title: Audit log
log.intro: Chronological record of operations on the data in practice mode: creating, changing, deleting, restoring, unlocking, exports and backups. Entries cannot be changed or removed without detection (HMAC signature chain). Training data (DEMO) is not recorded.

history.title: Change history
history.intro: Saved versions, newest first. Changes within 5 minutes in one session form one version.
history.empty: No saved versions. History covers changes since app version 1.2.
history.restoreText: This version becomes the current content. The current content stays in the history, so this can be undone too.
history.otherSpace: This version belongs to the other mode (practice / training).

trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Deleted entries are kept here for {{days}} days, then they are deleted permanently (with their change history). The audit log keeps only a note of the permanent deletion, without the name.
trash.purgeText: The entry and its whole change history will be deleted and cannot be recovered.
trash.emptyText: All entries in the trash and their change history will be deleted and cannot be recovered.

integrity.title: Integrity check
integrity.text: Checks that all data and versions can be decrypted and that no audit log entries were changed, removed or added.
integrity.okText: Log entries: {{entries}}, records: {{records}}, versions: {{versions}} – no issues.
integrity.badAudit: The audit log was changed outside the app (entry no. {{seq}}: {{reason}}).
integrity.badRecords: Records or versions that cannot be read: {{count}}. Restore your data from a backup.

export.pdfIntegrityOk: Integrity of the entry chain: confirmed (entries: {{entries}}).
export.pdfIntegrityBad: Integrity of the entry chain: MISMATCH at entry no. {{seq}}.
export.pdfNote: Log kept locally on the device. Entries are chain-signed (HMAC-SHA256) with a key available only with the password. People are identified by pseudonyms given by the user.
